steps: Slice the eggplant into 1/2-inch thick rounds. Salt both sides and let rest for 30 minutes to draw out moisture. Pat dry with paper towels.
In a large skillet, heat olive oil over medium heat. Fry the eggplant slices until golden brown on both sides. Remove and set aside on paper towels to drain excess oil.
In the same skillet, sauté thinly sliced onions until soft and translucent.
Add tomato sauce to the skillet with the onions and simmer for about 5 minutes.
Layer the fried eggplant slices in the skillet, spoon sauce over them, then add slices of fresh mozzarella on top.
Cover and cook on low heat until mozzarella melts and sauce bubbles, about 10 minutes.
Garnish with fresh basil if available and serve warm.
Scrub potatoes clean and pat dry.
Prick each potato several times with a fork.
Rub skin with olive oil and sprinkle with salt.
Place potatoes directly on oven rack and bake for 45-60 minutes until skins are crispy and interiors are fluffy.
Serve with butter, sour cream or toppings of choice.
